column1: place|/pleɪs/|n.; v.|地方；位置；放置|基础|space-positions|take place::发生;in place::在适当位置|The meeting will take place in the library.::会议将在图书馆举行。|Please place the books on the lower shelf.::请把书放在较低的架子上。

position|/pəˈzɪʃən/|n.|位置；职位；立场|基础|space-positions|in position::就位;a clear position::明确立场|The camera was in position before sunrise.::相机在日出前就已就位。|She explained her position on the proposed changes.::她解释了自己对拟议变更的立场。

location|/loʊˈkeɪʃən/|n.|地点；位置|四级|space-positions|a convenient location::便利的地点;the exact location::确切位置|The hotel has a convenient location near the station.::这家旅馆位置便利，靠近车站。|We could not find the exact location on the map.::我们无法在地图上找到确切位置。

direction|/dəˈrekʃən/|n.|方向；指导；发展趋势|基础|space-positions|in the direction of::朝……方向;change direction::改变方向|The path leads in the direction of the river.::这条小路通往河流的方向。|The project changed direction after the first review.::项目在首次审查后改变了方向。

distance|/ˈdɪstəns/|n.|距离；间隔|基础|space-positions|in the distance::在远处;a short distance::短距离|We could see a small boat in the distance.::我们能看到远处的一条小船。|The school is a short distance from our house.::学校离我们家不远。

near|/nɪr/|prep.; adj.; adv.|在……附近；近的；接近|基础|space-relations|near the station::在车站附近;in the near future::在不久的将来|There is a quiet park near the station.::车站附近有一个安静的公园。|We hope to return in the near future.::我们希望不久后回来。

far|/fɑːr/|adv.; adj.|远；很大程度地|基础|space-relations|far away::遥远;so far::到目前为止|The village is far away from the main road.::村庄离主路很远。|So far, the experiment has produced useful results.::到目前为止，实验取得了有用的结果。

above|/əˈbʌv/|prep.; adv.|在……上方；高于|基础|space-relations|above the clouds::在云层上方;above average::高于平均水平|A bird circled above the quiet lake.::一只鸟在平静的湖面上方盘旋。|Her score was above the class average.::她的分数高于班级平均水平。

below|/bɪˈloʊ/|prep.; adv.|在……下方；低于|基础|space-relations|below the surface::在表面以下;below average::低于平均水平|Small fish moved below the surface of the water.::小鱼在水面下游动。|The temperature fell below zero during the night.::夜间气温降到了零度以下。

between|/bɪˈtwiːn/|prep.; adv.|在……之间；介于|基础|space-relations|between two points::在两点之间;the difference between::……之间的差别|The path runs between the two buildings.::这条小路位于两栋建筑之间。|What is the difference between these two methods?::这两种方法之间有什么差别？

through|/θruː/|prep.; adv.|穿过；通过；从头到尾|基础|space-relations|walk through::走过;through the night::整夜|We walked through the forest before reaching the lake.::我们穿过森林后到达了湖边。|The team worked through the night to finish.::团队工作了整夜才完成任务。

across|/əˈkrɔːs/|prep.; adv.|横过；在……对面；遍及|基础|space-relations|across the street::在街对面;across the country::遍及全国|There is a small bakery across the street.::街对面有一家小面包店。|The survey collected answers from across the country.::调查收集了全国各地的回答。

along|/əˈlɔːŋ/|prep.; adv.|沿着；向前；一起|基础|space-relations|along the river::沿河;get along with::与……相处|We followed the path along the river.::我们沿着河边的小路走。|She gets along well with her new colleagues.::她和新同事相处得很好。

around|/əˈraʊnd/|prep.; adv.|围绕；在周围；大约|基础|space-relations|look around::四处看看;around the world::世界各地|We sat around the table to discuss the plan.::我们围坐在桌旁讨论计划。|The exhibition includes work from around the world.::展览包含来自世界各地的作品。

inside|/ˌɪnˈsaɪd/|prep.; adv.; n.|在里面；内部|基础|space-relations|inside the box::在盒子里;from the inside::从内部|There was a small note inside the box.::盒子里有一张小便条。|The door can only be opened from the inside.::这扇门只能从里面打开。

outside|/ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/|prep.; adv.; n.|在外面；外部|基础|space-relations|wait outside::在外面等;outside the building::在楼外|Please wait outside while we prepare the room.::我们准备房间时，请在外面等候。|A crowd gathered outside the building.::一群人聚集在楼外。
front|/frʌnt/|n.; adj.|前部；正面的|基础|space-relations|in front of::在……前面;the front page::头版|She sat in front of me during the lecture.::讲座期间，她坐在我前面。|The story appeared on the front page.::这则报道刊登在头版。

behind|/bɪˈhaɪnd/|prep.; adv.|在……后面；落后于|基础|space-relations|behind the house::在房屋后面;behind schedule::落后于计划|A narrow path leads behind the house.::一条窄路通往房屋后面。|The construction work is a week behind schedule.::建筑工程比计划落后一周。
left|/left/|adj.; adv.; n.|左边的；向左；左侧|基础|space-relations|turn left::向左转;on the left::在左边|Turn left when you reach the bridge.::到桥边时向左转。|The entrance is on the left side of the building.::入口在建筑物的左侧。

right|/raɪt/|adj.; adv.; n.|正确的；右边；权利|基础|space-relations|on the right::在右边;the right to::……的权利|The shop is on the right after the crossing.::过路口后，商店就在右边。|Everyone has the right to express an opinion.::每个人都有表达意见的权利。

travel|/ˈtrævəl/|v.; n.|旅行；传播；行进|基础|travel|travel abroad::出国旅行;travel by train::乘火车旅行|They plan to travel abroad after graduation.::他们计划毕业后出国旅行。|News can travel quickly through a small community.::消息可以在小社区里迅速传播。
journey|/ˈdʒɜːrni/|n.|旅程；历程|基础|travel|a long journey::长途旅行;the return journey::返程|The train journey took nearly five hours.::这段火车旅程花了将近五小时。|The return journey was much quieter.::返程安静得多。
trip|/trɪp/|n.; v.|短途旅行；绊倒|基础|travel|a day trip::一日游;trip over::被……绊倒|We took a day trip to the coast.::我们去海边进行了一日游。|Be careful not to trip over the cable.::小心别被电线绊倒。
arrive|/əˈraɪv/|v.|到达；来临|基础|arrive|arrive at::到达；得出;arrive in::抵达某地|We should arrive in the city before dark.::我们应该能在天黑前到达城市。|How did you arrive at that conclusion?::你是如何得出那个结论的？
arrival|/əˈraɪvəl/|n.|到达；到来；新来者|基础|arrive|on arrival::到达时;a new arrival::新来者|Please report to the office on arrival.::到达时请到办公室报到。|The arrival of the train changed our plans.::火车的到来改变了我们的计划。
depart|/dɪˈpɑːrt/|v.|离开；出发；背离|四级|depart|depart from::从……出发；背离;depart for::动身前往|The ship will depart for the island tomorrow.::这艘船明天将前往岛上。|The new design departs from the original plan.::新设计与原计划有所不同。

departure|/dɪˈpɑːrtʃər/|n.|离开；出发；偏离|基础|depart|the departure time::出发时间;a departure from::对……的偏离|Check the departure time before leaving home.::离家前请核对出发时间。|The proposal marks a departure from past practice.::这项提案标志着对以往做法的改变。

vehicle|/ˈviːəkəl/|n.|车辆；运载工具；传播媒介|基础|travel|a motor vehicle::机动车;a vehicle for::……的媒介|No vehicle is allowed on this narrow path.::这条窄路不允许任何车辆通行。|The exhibition became a vehicle for sharing local stories.::展览成为分享当地故事的媒介。

route|/ruːt/|n.|路线；途径|四级|travel|a bus route::公交路线;an alternative route::替代路线|This bus route passes near the university.::这条公交路线经过大学附近。|We found an alternative route around the closed road.::我们找到了一条绕过封闭道路的替代路线。

destination|/ˌdestɪˈneɪʃən/|n.|目的地；终点|基础|travel|a final destination::最终目的地;a popular destination::热门目的地|We reached our final destination before sunset.::我们在日落前到达了最终目的地。|The village has become a popular destination for walkers.::这个村庄已成为徒步者的热门目的地。
